title: Sharpen a Blurry Dog Photo
tests: Enhances a blurry supplied photo rather than replacing its subject or merely enlarging the blur.

faults.what: The delivered image is 1024 × 1024 rather than the requested 640 × 640.

judge.summary: The dog is substantially clearer and looks natural, with the pose and framing preserved, but the image needs resizing to the requested 640-pixel long edge.

must_haves.item: The same golden retriever from blurry-dog.jpg remains recognisable in the same pose.
must_haves.why: The golden retriever retains its front-facing seated pose, open mouth, hanging tongue, and matching placement of its paws and tail.

must_haves.item: The dog's visible contours and facial features are clearer than in the blurry source.
must_haves.why: The eyes, nose, mouth, ears, paws, and body outline are substantially better defined.

must_haves.item: Fur and edges look natural, without pronounced sharpening halos or invented decorative detail.
must_haves.why: The fur has plausible texture and soft edges, without conspicuous halos or decorative additions.

must_haves.item: The background and full original framing are preserved.
must_haves.why: The square composition retains the full dog and surrounding lawn, trees, and distant background in their original arrangement.

must_haves.item: The delivered image has a 640-pixel long edge and preserves the source aspect ratio.
must_haves.why: The square aspect ratio is preserved, but the delivered image is 1024 × 1024, not 640 × 640.
